articles.title: Robot Fish Are Spying on the Ocean's Biggest Secrets!
articles.summary: Imagine a hurricane getting super strong because of a secret hot spot in the ocean. Ravi Pappu is building tiny robot sensors that dive deep to find those hidden dangers. His company's devices are only 3 feet long and can be dropped from planes!

articles.title: From Dorm Room to Changing the World: MIT's Coolest Ideas
articles.summary: Imagine an app that helps kids who can't speak tell their caregivers what they need—just by wearing an Apple Watch! That's one of the winning ideas at MIT's big social entrepreneurship party. Over 200 students showed off projects that help people and the planet.

articles.title: The Artist Who Turned Cleaning into Art—And Got Famous!
articles.summary: Mierle Laderman Ukeles made art out of mopping floors and taking care of her baby. A new movie shows how she became the official artist of New York City's garbage trucks! She says famous artists like Jackson Pollock never changed diapers—so she made that her art.
